about: Rule-pack SDK and runner mutants (wf10 LINT3). Killed by the in-process status tests (lint_test.go) and the process runner tests (run_test.go, full tier).

mutants.name: lint3-sdk-panic-completes
mutants.from: findings, err = nil, fmt.Errorf("rule panicked: %v", recovered)
mutants.rule: A rule that panics fails; it never completes.

mutants.name: lint3-sdk-unavailable-runs
mutants.rule: A rule whose required family is unavailable is skipped: facts-unavailable, never run over missing facts.

mutants.name: lint3-sdk-bounds-from-pass
mutants.from: if err := validateFinding(finding, source); err != nil {
mutants.to: if err := validateFinding(finding, newSourceBounds(pass.Snapshot.Sources)); err != nil {
mutants.rule: Findings are validated against the admitted sources, captured before the rule runs.

mutants.name: lint3-sdk-imports-internal
mutants.rule: The SDK imports no compiler internals.

mutants.name: lint3-run-starts-for-off-rules
mutants.rule: An off rule is decided without starting the pack.

mutants.name: lint3-run-stderr-on-stdout
mutants.rule: A pack's stderr is diagnostics, kept apart from its response frame.

mutants.name: lint3-run-stale-accepted
mutants.rule: A response for another snapshot revision is stale: the pack fails.

mutants.name: lint3-run-masquerade-accepted
mutants.rule: A response naming a rule that was not requested is invalid: the pack fails.

mutants.name: lint3-run-oversized-accepted
mutants.rule: A response over the findings limit is oversized: the pack fails, never truncated.

mutants.name: lint3-run-crash-after-response-accepted
mutants.rule: A complete response does not excuse a failing exit.

mutants.name: lint3-run-kills-only-the-pack
mutants.rule: A timeout kills the pack's whole process group.

mutants.name: lint3-run-span-unchecked
mutants.to: if reason := validateFindings(result.Findings, e.source); false && reason != "" {
mutants.rule: A finding outside the admitted source fails its rule.
